deals.deal: Rotisserie Chicken $5.99, Save Up to $2
deals.desc: Giant Food's weekly ad offers its hot or cold Giant Rotisserie Chicken at $5.99, up to $2 off regular price.

deals.deal: Buy $50 in Gift Cards, Get a Free $10 Bonus Card
deals.desc: Buy $50 or more in Panera gift cards in-cafe, in the app or online and receive a free $10 bonus card redeemable in January, no code needed.

deals.deal: Free Delivery on Every Order Through the End of 2026
deals.desc: Through the end of 2026, delivery orders placed on mezeh.com or in the Mezeh app carry no delivery fee, for anyone, no code or account needed. Build-your-own bowls, wraps and family packs all qualify. Stated on Mezeh's own homepage.
deals.region: VA, MD, DC, PA, NC, SC, GA, FL & TX

deals.deal: Free Birria Grilled Burrito Dipper with Any Purchase for Moe Rewards Members
deals.desc: Through Sunday, November 22: Moe Rewards members (free account) get one Grilled Burrito Dipper with the returning shredded-beef Birria free with any purchase, in the app, online or in the restaurant. Single use; the fine print says the offer goes to select members, so check the Rewards tab in the app before ordering. Not valid with dipper pans, other offers or third-party delivery; participating locations. Stated on moes.com.

deals.deal: $5 Off a $10+ Order with Code THANK5 in the Pancheros App
deals.desc: All November: enter code THANK5 in the Pancheros app (free account) for $5 off any order of $10 or more, which covers a burrito or bowl plus a side or drink. The homepage states no exclusions; one code per order. Stated on Pancheros' own homepage.

deals.deal: Sub of the Week: $2 Off This Week's Featured Whole Sub
deals.desc: Every week Publix takes $2 off one featured whole deli sub (a Boar's Head turkey sub or the Publix Deli Ultimate Sub, for example, about $8.99 instead of $10.99), fully customizable at the counter, online or in the app. The featured sub changes with the weekly ad; the deli's weekly specials page lists it.

deals.deal: Kids Eat Free with Every Adult Entree, Dine-In
deals.desc: Every day, dine-in only: kids 12 and under get a free mini rice bowl with each adult entree (a Premium Bowl, Sandweech or Large Salad), up to two kids per adult entree. Children must be there when you order; not valid online or through delivery apps. A kids bowl is usually $6.49. Stated on Pita Way's own specials page.

deals.deal: Monday Special: Legacy Bowl and a Drink for $9.99, Online Orders
deals.desc: Mondays only, when you order on Pita Way's own website or app: a Legacy Bowl with your choice of protein, base and sauce, plus a fountain drink or bottled water, for $9.99. The bowl alone is usually $12.99. No code or account needed; cannot be combined with other discounts. Stated on Pita Way's own specials page.

deals.deal: $6.99 Build Your Own Bowl on Mondays (Acai, Pitaya, Oatmeal or Yogurt Base)
deals.desc: Mondays only at 14 Saladworks stores that also serve Frutta Bowls, including Fairfax (9414 Fairfax Blvd), Virginia Beach, Chesterfield and Newport News: build your own 16 oz bowl for $6.99 with a base, granola, fruit and a topping. The regular build-your-own bowl is $9.99 for a mini and $11.99 for a regular. Order at the counter or pick the "6.99 BYO Bowl" category on that store's Saladworks ordering page, where it appears on Mondays; no code or account needed. If your store's page does not show the category on a Monday, it is not taking part.
deals.region: Some stores only: VA, NJ, PA, DE, FL, NC, TN, TX

deals.deal: Kids Eat Free with the Purchase of an Adult Bowl
deals.desc: Every day at Roots Natural Kitchen: a child under 12 eats free with each adult grain or salad bowl purchased. The child has to be there with you; no code or account needed. Roots states no day or time limits, so confirm at the counter when you order. Shown on every page of Roots' own site, including the Fairfax, Virginia location page.
deals.region: VA, PA, OH, NC, DE & WV

deals.deal: Kids Eat Free on Mondays After 4 PM with an Adult Entree
deals.desc: Every Monday after 4 PM, in the restaurant only: one free kids meal for each adult entree purchased, for kids 10 and under, up to four per order. No code or account needed; not valid with other discounts. Stated on Cowboy Chicken's own Kids Corral page.

deals.deal: PERi Buffalo Meal Deal: Sandwich or 6 Wings with PERi Chips and a Drink for $11.99
deals.desc: Limited time: a PERi Buffalo Pulled Chicken Sandwich or six flame-grilled PERi Buffalo wings, plus PERi Chips and a fountain drink, for $11.99. The sandwich alone is $10, so the chips and drink come to about $2. No account or code needed; order in the restaurant or online. Stated on Nando's own promotions page.
deals.region: DC, MD, VA, IL, TX & GA

deals.deal: $9 Regular Poke Bowl on Mondays
deals.desc: Every Monday at the Clarksville and Marriottsville, Maryland locations: a regular-size poke bowl is $9 instead of the usual $14. No code or account needed. The Annapolis and Washington, DC locations are not included. Stated under Weekly Specials on Blowfish Poke's own homepage.

deals.deal: $10 Monster Mondays: Any Monster Burrito or Bowl for $10
deals.desc: Every Monday: the Monster size burrito or bowl, Freebirds' large, is $10 in-store when you mention the deal, or online. A Monster burrito is usually about $14.75. Extras cost more; not combinable with other offers and not available through third-party delivery; no account needed. Stated on Freebirds' own homepage.

deals.deal: Buy One, Get One Free Gyros, Pitas or Appetizers with Code BOGO, Online Orders
deals.desc: Limited time at Michigan locations: add two qualifying items from the same category on the chain's own ordering site (for example a Chicken Great Greek Gyro, Feta-Filled Kebab Gyro or Falafel Pita, $10.99 to $12.99 each) and enter promo code BOGO at checkout to get one free. One BOGO per order; categories cannot be mixed; no account needed. Seen on the Byron Center, Ann Arbor, West Bloomfield, Troy and Allen Park ordering pages.

deals.deal: Choose Two for $8.99 with Code 1551: Half Salad, Soup, Sandwich or Pasta Plus a Side
deals.desc: Limited time at select cafes: any Choose Two combo (two of a half salad, half soup, half sandwich or half pasta) plus a side for $8.99, all day. Enter code 1551 at online checkout or mention it in the cafe; no account needed, not valid on third-party delivery. The offer is set cafe by cafe: it shows for Fair Oaks in Fairfax, Bethesda, both DC cafes and cafes in Illinois, Texas, Georgia, Pennsylvania and Tennessee, so pick your cafe on Corner Bakery's offers page to confirm before you go.
deals.region: Select cafes: DC, MD, VA, IL, TX, GA, PA & TN

deals.deal: Medi Mondays: $5 Off a Build Your Own Bowl or $10 Off a Family Meal for Club Luna Members
deals.desc: Every Monday, Club Luna Rewards members (free account) pick one in the Luna Grill app: $5 off a Build Your Own Bowl (app-only item) or $10 off a Family Meal. One offer per transaction; not combinable with the rewards balance. Stated on Luna Grill's own Club Luna rewards page.

deals.deal: $5 Off Two Regular Rice Bowls with Code CE41FLDF
deals.desc: Standing coupon on Yoshinoya's own coupons page: add two regular rice bowls (chicken, beef or veggie) in-store, online or in the app and apply code CE41FLDF at checkout for $5 off; no account needed. Not valid on ribeye, salmon or limited-time items; participating locations. The same page lists $5 off two large bowls (code CRSA6MCE), $5 off two combo bowls (C6Z88J4A) and 20% off $20 (C9M7P979), 25% off $25 (C3FBHN3D) or 30% off $30 (up to $10 off).

deals.deal: Double Fire Deal: Two Charbroiled Chicken or Tofu Bowls with Two Add-Ons for $20
deals.desc: Limited time: two charbroiled chicken or tofu rice bowls plus two add-ons for $20 together, at participating locations, no account or code needed. Flame Broiler bowls are usually about $11 to $12 each before add-ons. Stated on Flame Broiler's own homepage.

deals.deal: $1 Bottomless Fountain Drinks for PERi-Perks Members
deals.desc: PERi-Perks members (free account) can add a bottomless fountain drink to any meal for $1 instead of the usual $3.99, in app, online or in-restaurant.
deals.region: DC, MD, VA, IL, TX & GA

deals.deal: Moe Monday: Discounted Burrito or Bowl with Free Chips and Salsa for Moe Rewards Members
deals.desc: Every Monday, Moe Rewards members (free account) get a full-size burrito or bowl at a reduced price with the always-free chips and salsa, in the restaurant, online or in the app. The offer appears automatically in the Moe Rewards account each Monday; no code. Moe's says the price varies by location (commonly $6.99 to $8.99), so check the app before ordering. Single use per Monday; add-ons extra; not valid with other offers or third-party delivery. Stated on Moe's own Moe Monday and offers pages.

deals.deal: Kids Eat Free: Free Chicken or Tofu Mini Bowl with Each Full-Price Entree
deals.desc: Every day: one free kids Chicken or Tofu Mini Bowl with the purchase of any full-price entree, weekdays after 4 PM and all day Saturday and Sunday, at all WaBa Grill locations. No account or coupon needed. Stated in WaBa Grill's own press release and on its homepage.
deals.expires: Weekdays after 4 PM, all day weekends

deals.deal: Club Luna Kids Eat Free: Free Kids Meal with Each Adult Entree, Dine-In
deals.desc: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday, Club Luna Rewards members (free app account) get one free kids meal per adult entree, up to two per check, for children 10 and under, dine-in only with the child present. Show the offer in the Luna Grill app when ordering. All locations except San Diego Airport; not combinable with other offers.

deals.deal: MyPollo Monday: Original Family Meal for $15 (Regularly $20.99)
deals.desc: Every Monday, MyPollo Rewards members (free app account) get the Original Family Meal, citrus-marinated grilled chicken with family-size sides, for $15 instead of the $20.99 listed on the chain's site. Order in the app or online with the reward applied, or show the app in the restaurant; participating Florida locations.
